name: Phosphoric acid
why: Intermediate of phosphate fertiliser: burned phosphorus is hydrated to the acid, which ammonia then neutralises

name: Monoammonium phosphate (MAP)
why: Nitrogen and phosphorus fertiliser made by neutralising phosphoric acid with ammonia

name: Urea
why: Main nitrogen fertiliser, made from ammonia and carbon dioxide

name: Potassium sulfate (sulfate of potash)
why: Chloride-free potassium fertiliser; makeable anywhere potassium and sulfuric acid exist, as lunar KREEP potassium can be
